text: Three years ago, a car hit a cyclist and drove off. No camera. No plate.
Most people would remember a grey blur.
Silver hatchback. Plate seven, K, R, four, one, nine.
Dent on the back left door. A little pine tree air freshener.
Tuesday, March third. Four seventeen p.m.
The police closed a three year old case... because a sixteen year old never forgets anything.
Everyone's memory quietly edits itself. Yours never has.
What if you could never forget anything?
